summary: TD SYNNEX filed an 8-K on November 5, 2026 disclosing that on November 2, 2026 it entered a $1,750 million senior unsecured Term Loan Credit Agreement with initial lenders, Bank of America as administrative agent, and BofA Securities as lead arranger and bookrunner. Proceeds refinanced in full the existing $750 million term loan due September 1, 2027, with the remainder earmarked for general corporate purposes including acquisitions. The facility matures November 2, 2029, carries no scheduled amortization, cannot be reborrowed, and prices at SOFR plus 1.00%-1.625% based on public debt rating. This is routine financing, not a special situation. Watch leverage covenants and acquisition-related drawdowns.
